protocol.question: Does reducing eta tenfold while retaining both traces alter the full recorded trajectory and reduce its weight movement?
protocol.selection: No policy selection. Report every condition; smaller updates or different actions do not establish profitable learning.

unchanged.imported_memory: same historical trained weights and u/w

verification: All three original carry controls reproduce every full-neuron count/voltage bin and every stored memory value before either new arm starts.
All arms start from identical imported memory and fresh dynamics; lower eta may change the first image trajectory.
Independently reconstruct every rate, u/w and float32 weight at the declared eta; check boundary continuity, full weights, input identity and decoder.
Compare every lower-rate observation against its matching eta=.001 control, including input-matched whole-network differences.
protocol.interpretation: One bounded historical mechanism assay. Original feedback pulses remain fixed; no accounts, feedback recomputation, returns, fresh holdout or policy promotion. Native propagation occurs only in the cloud. A subsequent prospective cost-aware comparison is required for trading evidence.
